newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IndMin to submit anti-dumping legislation.
newsitem.headline: Czech IndMin to submit anti-dumping legislation.

text.p: Czech Industry and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy said on Friday he would submit a draft law to the government protecting the country against the dumping of imports.

"It is a precise definition of legal conditions allowing, if it is proved that goods are imported at a dumping price, to adopt temporary or definitive anti-dumping tariff," Dlouhy told a news conference.
The law must first be approved by the cabinet and then by the parliament.
